text: The Supplier delivers within 14 calendar days of receiving a purchase order.
Partial deliveries are allowed; the remainder is delivered and invoiced once received.
Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Supplier shall supply packaging materials to the Buyer against purchase orders issued by the Buyer.
Each purchase order forms an integral part of this Agreement.
Every invoice must state the number of the purchase order it bills.
The Supplier may invoice only goods that the Buyer has received and recorded in a goods receipt.
Each delivery may be invoiced once only; an invoice resubmitted under the same or a different number will be rejected.
